strategy.summary: Two Orders API operations have no test: GET /products/{id} (getProduct) and POST /orders/{id}/cancel (cancelOrder). Add vitest API tests beside the existing ones that call each by the spec's method and path against the in-process app, covering the 200 response and every documented error (404; plus 409 for cancel), asserting status, content type and body shape. Also bring the existing GET /orders/{id} success test up to the spec: it still asserts the old `totalCents` field, while the spec's Order now has `total: Money {amount, currency}`; only that property changes, every other check stays.
inScope: Updating the existing GET /orders/{id} 200 assertion to the spec's Order.total Money shape
outOfScope: Changing the spec or the application
Restructuring the existing specs (e.g. extracting the duplicated server setup) beyond what this ticket needs; listed as a follow-up
assumptions: The app runs for real in-process (createApp() on port 0, as the existing specs do); nothing is faked.
New cases go into the existing test/products.test.js and test/orders.test.js, which already start the server, so no setup is copied into a new file.
Each spec file gets its own fresh store (createStore per createApp), so product data in products.test.js equals the exported PRODUCTS seed; cancel tests place their own orders first.

risks.description: Existing getOrder test asserts the old totalCents field and fails against the app/spec
risks.mitigation: TC6 updates it to total {amount, currency}, keeping every other check

risks.description: Cancel could return the wrong status or not persist
risks.mitigation: TC3 asserts the full Order with status 'cancelled'; TC5 proves a second cancel is refused, which needs the first to have been stored

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /products/{id} returns 200 with a Product (id, name, priceCents, stock) for an existing id
GET /products/{id} returns 404 with an Error body {error: string} for an unknown id
POST /orders/{id}/cancel on a placed order returns 200 with the Order, status 'cancelled' and total as Money
POST /orders/{id}/cancel returns 404 with an Error body for an unknown order
POST /orders/{id}/cancel returns 409 with an Error body when the order is already cancelled
GET /orders/{id} returns the Order with total as Money {amount, currency} per the spec

testCases.rationale: cancelOrder (POST /orders/{id}/cancel) has no test: success response

testCases.title: is 404 when cancelling an unknown order
is 409 when the order is already cancelled

testCases.title: returns an order with its total
